title: the launcher with no flag at all is denied by the guard: --build, --brief, --mode and --worktree are required
source: intended: owner decision, defect N-29: a bare launch is not allowed
intent: INTENDED behavior (owner decision, defect N-29). The dispatcher's one launch line must carry --build, --brief, --mode direct and --worktree path:<primary>, so a bare `<launcher> launch` is denied with `--build is required` instead of being left for the launcher to reject. This case was `bash-allows-bare-launch`; it is converted in place.
